observations: Evoker directInteract registers EvokerWololoAbility. Sheep canTarget uses native goal predicate; other entities require Wololo component not converted. Client run returns true immediately; server stores custom target and calls native canStart/start then sets started, with nominal ability cooldown0. update invokes goal tick while custom valid-target and spellCooldown>0, else stop and set spellNONE. Native Evoker.WololoGoal and inherited spellcasting tick/start not in reviewed source chain; native timing, rejection prerequisites and final cast not established.

WololoGoalMixin only forces canStart true at convertibleSheepPredicate field access if custom valid target; earlier native guards remain unexpanded. Interface default predicate throws AssertionError; actual mixin/runtime application not proven.

Non-sheep cast calls maybeGet(component).wololo; method changes false->true once and syncs. Component stores converted boolean only when true; reader changes only if key present, so same-instance missing-key load leaves prior flag. This is not a control owner UUID, immunity reason or confirmed possession result.

Client component supplies classic Enderman eyes only when converted; renderer replaces buffer if layer exists; Enderman movement particle becomes smoke. These are state presentation, not authoritative control refusal receipts. Source is read without rendering or editing art.

Bounded repository-wide Wololo references show state/ability/component registration plus eyes, particles and camera shader suppression. No Wololo flag consumer granting possession was found in that scan. Base converted_mobs admission reads PossessedData.wasConvertedUnderPossession, a different datum; soulless reads SoulHolder flag/tag and does not read Wololo flag. Do not infer a conversion-unlocks-possession mechanic from names or visual cues.

Reclamation exploratory whole effect queues amplifier+1 only at duration1 then END_SERVER_TICK reduces Attrition and clears weak map; split/dissociation removes current body effect and requests clear sound if present; freezes duration while incorporeal. Producer/native status timing/Attrition chain not reopened and no new immunity claim or credit.

complete_closest_decisions.count_unit: one semantically distinct game implementation site with complete containing methods and call-chain context; wrappers/ports/constant-only variants merged
complete_closest_decisions.full_chain_observation: 完整RisingZombie172行、renderer75/state7/model18与GraveyardFeature.place全文实际读；实际实体factory/属性、feature注册、主Mod constructor注册和client setup listener/具体renderer与layer绑定核对。真实graveyard的metadata spawner分支设置RISING_ZOMBIE类型；actor原生aiStep观察最近玩家并启动同步counter，server推进到>=130调用convertTo vanillaZombie，callback写原HP/方向。在该临时actor类型存续时isImmobile恒true、knockback/doPush/pushEntities空、ride/fluid/portal拒绝，类型替换后这些本类override不再属于继任者。同步counter同时驱动refreshDimensions/height、renderer shadow/rotations和model腿显示。
complete_closest_decisions.concrete_observation: 一整套临时actor类型承担控制抵抗及原生转换结束生命周期1；不按七个空hook、130常量、影子或粒子拆计。与Iron corpse拒伤触发幂等唤醒并替换Boss、Vampirism永久block代理、Gorgon捕获保存或Wizardry方块还原不同：本例控制拒绝不靠可移除effect，本体可正常受其他伤害，观察触发有限存续然后普通类型继承。isInvulnerableTo只IN_WALL且不super，不可称出土期全伤免疫。native knockback空不证明setPos/直接速度写入也无效。
complete_closest_decisions.application_to_boss_immune: Boss拒控灰字要绑定真实目标及其生命周期；actor替换可结束策略而不经effectRemoval，不能把旧目标缓存或粒子附给新类型。出土声/粒子是状态进展而非拒控收据，不建议引入转换玩法；普通阴阳仍无灰字要求。
complete_closest_decisions.limitations: 已全文主审上述本地文件和helper列出完整place/register/setup；Beanification外部扫描实现、继承isLookingAtMe/native convertTo内部与vanillaZombie控制未展开，不声称UUID保留/转换成功/精确LOS或130墙钟tick。首次counter写无serverguard，不能美化全权威；convertTo结果未检查，无自定义counter NBT保存。碰撞height0..130与render0..80..120不是同一边界。实际模板是否含marker/刷怪是否触发、声音及双端像素未测。CottonCandor/RockRider整类块注释本岗已全文读，排除0；本批仅1。

complete_closest_decisions.full_chain_observation: 注册的MindControl实际继承SpellRay：ItemWand原生右键/蓄力tick→当前绑定spell、canCast→服务端cast→shootSpell自有rayTrace先裁剪方块再选实体→onEntityHit→canControl明确isNonBoss/EntityLiving/INpc/EvilWizard/黑名单判断。拒绝在server给玩家caster.sendStatusMessage(TextComponentTranslation, true)，不调用startControlling；接受才服务端存controller UUID及effect。onEntityHit对活体拒绝也true，法杖因此支付法力/设冷却并发注册的PacketCastSpell到当前维度，客户端enqueue按casterID找玩家重跑spell.cast，用于本地射线/装饰粒子，不是服务端拒控原因回执。接受分支的50tick重选目标/目标事件、效果结束清目标同类全文已读但不额外计数。
complete_closest_decisions.concrete_observation: Boss、玩家、NPC与黑名单拒绝共用spell.resist文案；明确目标身份来自服务端canControl，不依赖零伤害。文本发给施法者overlay，参数target.getName与本地化带element颜色spell组件，不是灰色头顶字。拒绝仍返回施法成功true，技能法力/生存冷却照扣；冷却控制施法，不是每Boss/原因的回执限频，创造模式还免该冷却。S2C只携casterID/spellID/modifiers/hand，不含目标ID/UUID/维度或拒控原因；虽然按维度发送，客户端延迟后从current world查ID且重做射线，无法保证粒子与服务端原目标一致。ClientProxy入口未空world保护，缺失caster只告警，非待解析队列。MindControl客户端20个暗魔法粒子对接受/拒绝均有，不是拒控专属微光；通用施法声同样不能当免疫嗡鸣。
complete_closest_decisions.application_to_boss_immune: 原生拒控结果可以与施法成功并存，正式Boss反馈应挂到确切拒控分支，不以整个cast返回或HP差推断。服务端目标锚定/原因回执优于客户端重射线；动作栏只作语义对照，不能冒充灰字。普通体质不因共享resist提示而新增要求。
complete_closest_decisions.limitations: 完整审阅所列核心方法及自有控制拒绝/施法回放链，未运行；法力/修饰计算、接受后AI检索辅助、美术ParticleBuilder内部和原版overlay底层不是本条研究主题，未据它们宣称完整画面/声音/同步验收。目标Boss的isNonBoss原版实现未展开，记录为API条件而非列出全部Boss覆盖。未读语言资源，不虚构中英文实际文字或灰色。Arc与MagicDamage只作另行候选，不由本条顺带计数。
